_meta.description: Precision case. Financial transactions, is_fraud at 3% (32:1). No post-event features exist. amount separates the classes perfectly (single-feature AUC 1.0, r=0.84) because fraud amounts were injected as extremes, but a transaction's amount is known when it is scored, so it is signal, not leakage. Identifiers (transaction_id, merchant_id) are info-level notes under the skill's policy. user_id's 8.4% nulls may be noted.

forbidden_findings.note: Known at scoring time; strong separation is the fraud signal itself. Critical is wrong.
Identifier: exclude from features, but it is not target leakage (skill policy).

note_on_max: Identifier notes, a user_id null-pattern note and perhaps an amount caveat.
